newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher as Komercni surges.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher as Komercni surges.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rose 1.4 percent to 519.3 on Tuesday boosted by continued strong gains to Komercni Banka.
Dealers remained at a loss to explain the surge, which has seen the bank's shares rise by almost 10 percent in two days.

Some said the gains were driven by renewed foreign interest after a run of sharp falls. Others said they had seen little buying from abroad. But the most commmon reaction was surprise in the light of poor first half earnings results announced last week.
"I don't know why today it's rising so far. For me it's very strange because just a few days ago everybody was trashing komercni," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
The other big gainer of the day was SPT Telecom which jumped 165 crowns, 4.3 percent, to 4,040. SPT, uniquely among the major issues, posted strong first half earnings results last week.
Power utility CEZ repeated the same trading pattern seen on Monday. It fell sharply at the fixing but recovered to close down just four crowns at 919.
Activity remained low with turnover at 583 million crowns.
